name: International Affairs
source:
Do YOU have what it takes to seduce a world leader?! Set in the ultra-exclusive world of the UN, International Affairs challenges players to romance powerful heads of state while attempting to uncover an urgent and sinister threat to global security. With fully branching paths, jaw-dropping dialogue, and a dazzling array of globetrotting hunks to choose from, the prospect of achieving world peace has never been so sensual!

Choose from a plethora of fully datable world leaders including Drumpf, the stable, orange genius determined to make dating sims great again; Poutine, a Russian bear lover and leather daddy extraordinaire; Kim, an angry Asian dictator with something to prove; Macaroon, a suave playboy with expertise in the art of “French” kissing; and Justin Truffaut, the kind, considerate Canadian next door.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1043200/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你有能力吸引世界领袖吗？！《国际事务》以联合国这个极其独特的世界为背景，挑战玩家与强大的国家元首恋爱，同时试图揭露全球安全面临的紧迫而险恶的威胁。完全分支的道路，令人瞠目结舌的对话，以及一系列令人眼花缭乱的环游世界的帅哥可供选择，实现世界和平的前景从未如此感性！

从众多完全有数据记录的世界领导人中进行选择，其中包括德朗普夫（Drumpf），这位稳定的橙色天才决心让约会模拟游戏再次变得伟大；Poutine，俄罗斯熊爱好者和非凡的皮革爸爸；金，一位愤怒的亚洲独裁者，需要证明一些事情；马卡龙，一位温文尔雅的花花公子，擅长“法式”接吻艺术；还有贾斯汀·特吕弗 (Justin Truffaut)，他是隔壁善良、体贴的加拿大人。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1043200/]Steam[/url]]
